newsitem.title: USA: Dravo ends investment banking review.
newsitem.headline: Dravo ends investment banking review.

text.p: Dravo Corp said Monday that the investment banking review initiated last fall has failed to produce a transaction favorable to the best interests of its shareholders. As a result, the company has concluded the review.
The company said that internal expansion, the development of new businesses and selective acquisitions are the best means available for achieving its growth objectives.
The company said in April it was engaged in discussions with prospective buyers as part of the review.

Dravo said that its lime production capacity has increased by more than 60 percent during the 1990s, and the utilization of its lime-based clean air technology has grown by nearly 40 percent during that period.

It added that this growth is attributable to increases in lime utilization in the electric utility and pulp and paper markets, and said that the company believes it is solidly positioned to benefit from continued growth in these and other important lime markets.
